context: Two teens trade tips about creator hobbies after school
purpose: Teach: イイ/雑記/ブログランキング/オヤジ/幾ら/つづけ/有無/不快

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、最近イイ感じの雑記ブログ見つけたんだよね。
lines.en: Hey Riku, I found a really nice casual blog lately.
lines.style: Bright excited teen girl sharing a discovery casually after school.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、誰が書いてるの?もしかしてブログランキングに載ってるやつ?
lines.en: Oh yeah? Who writes it? Is it one on the blog ranking?
lines.style: Curious laid-back teen boy responding with genuine interest and rising tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そう、ランキング上位の人で、なんかうちのオヤジくらいの歳の人なんだけど文章が上手くてさ。
lines.en: Yeah, top of the ranking, around my dad's age but writes really well.
lines.style: Animated teen girl explaining with mild surprise and admiration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: オヤジ世代かよ。サブスクとかあるの?幾らくらいかかんの?
lines.en: Dad generation, huh? Does he have a subscription? How much does it cost?
lines.style: Teasing skeptical teen boy asking practical questions with a smirk.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 無料無料。ただ毎日書きつづけてるのがすごくて、もう三年だって。
lines.en: Totally free. What's amazing is he keeps writing daily, three years now.
lines.style: Impressed teen girl emphasizing dedication with widening eyes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 三年かあ。コメント欄って荒れたりしない?不快なやつ湧くじゃん普通。
lines.en: Three years, wow. Doesn't the comment section get nasty? Trolls usually appear.
lines.style: Realistic teen boy raising a practical concern about online creators.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがさ、悪意の有無に関わらず変なコメントは即削除するらしいよ。
lines.en: Apparently he deletes weird comments instantly regardless of malicious intent.
lines.style: Knowing teen girl sharing insider info with a satisfied nod.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、ちゃんとしてんじゃん。俺も今度読んでみよっかな。
lines.en: Huh, sounds well-managed. Maybe I'll check it out sometime too.
lines.style: Convinced teen boy showing reluctant approval with casual interest.
